1:
SELECT DISTINCT e."id", e."name", e."event_space", e."capacity"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE e."event_space" LIKE '%Banquet Hall%'
   OR e."event_space" LIKE '%Conference Room%'
  AND CAST(e."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;
3:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
4:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name" AS restaurant_name, r."food_service", r."cuisine"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE r."food_service" LIKE '%Café%'
   OR r."cuisine" LIKE '%Italian%'
ORDER BY r."name";
6:
SELECT DISTINCT
    "s"."name" AS "staff_name",
    "s"."role" AS "staff_role",
    "s"."language" AS "staff_language"
FROM
    "staff" "s"
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM("s"."role")) LIKE '%chef%'
    OR (
        LOWER(TRIM("s"."role")) LIKE '%server%'
        AND LOWER(TRIM("s"."language")) LIKE '%english%'
    )
ORDER BY
    "s"."role", "s"."name";
8:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s1.name AS chef_name,
    s1.language AS chef_language,
    s2.name AS server_name,
    s2.language AS server_language
FROM
    staff s1
JOIN
    staff s2 ON s1.language = s2.language
WHERE
    s1.role LIKE 'Chef'
    AND s2.role LIKE 'Server'
    AND s1.language LIKE 'English';
112:
SELECT r."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "internships" i
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "internships_responsibilities" ir
        WHERE ir."internshipid" = i."id"
        AND ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
    )
);
113:
SELECT DISTINCT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";
114:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
267:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s."city" AS city,
    t."officelocation" AS street_address
FROM
    "teachers" t
JOIN
    "students" s ON TRUE ;
